capabilities: Write random generator tables in plain Markdown with weighted entries, ranges and bindings
Render interactive rollers with Roll and Copy buttons in Reading view
Reuse table data from other notes via source references
Convert Markdown dice tables into rollable columns
Roll and copy the active note's generator via a command
extras: Pre-release builds can be installed via BRAT; licensing details for the adapted CC0 template are in NOTICE.md.
motivation: The README says it began as an Obsidian adaptation of Mike Shea's CC0 generator template.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to define random generator tables in notes and roll them interactively, so RPG prep relies on external generator sites or manual rolling.

relations.evidence: This plugin began as an Obsidian adaptation of this CC0 generator template by Mike Shea
Dice Roller links inside Markdown table cells are interpreted as Trolls table references at roll time

summary: Markdown-based random generator engine that turns note tables into Perchance-style rollable generators with interactive rollers for tabletop RPG prep.
